channel.title: Deep Press Analysis — English Feed
channel.description: In-depth research into corporate power, global governance, and economic dependencies.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 9, 2026
item.description: A deep systemic analysis reveals that behind the facade of tech giant earnings and AI expansion, cascading physical supply chain failures are quietly unfolding. Critical anomalies, including major legal scandals in Taiwanese PCB manufacturing, the synchronous shutdown of essential chemical plants, and a severe shortage of transformer steel, threaten to spark a "Hardware-Energy Decoupling Shock" that could paralyze global infrastructure within months.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 8, 2026
item.description: A systemic analysis of the global debt architecture, highlighting the shift toward direct financial repression, the monetization of sovereign debt, and the fragmentation of global liquidity through alternative clearing systems like BRICS Pay and mBridge.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 7, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of cascading global crises. We dissect the fundamental consequences of the US/Israeli assassination of Ayatollah Khamenei, the resulting energy shock from the Strait of Hormuz blockade, and how the expanding Russia-Iran military nexus is aggressively prolonging the grueling war of attrition in Ukraine.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 6, 2026
item.description: A comprehensive analysis of U.S. export controls reveals a strategic shift from entity-based bans to systemic management of the AI and semiconductor supply chains. Key updates include new mandatory domestic allocations for critical minerals, strict case-by-case licensing for advanced computing chips like the NVIDIA H200, and comprehensive KYC rules for cloud providers.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 5, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of defense supply chains and institutional capital rotation. Today's focus: US localization of critical minerals, multi-billion defense contracts, and smart money aggressively shorting AI while pivoting to housing.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 4, 2026
item.description: Analytical report on the transformation of U.S. and E.U. state control infrastructure through AI and biometrics. We dissect the shift towards predictive surveillance, data fusion, and the privatization of state coercion by defense tech monopolies.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 3, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of institutional narrative control. Today's focus: the systemic semantic hijacking used to legitimize the militarization of human cognition, behavioral engineering via Nudge theory, and the legal confiscation of private assets through bail-in mechanisms.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 2, 2026
item.description: Capital and Autonomy: Reverse-engineering sovereignty within the modern nation-state system across wealth tiers from $1M to $10B+, examining structural leverage, regulatory boundaries, and legal myths.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 1, 2026
item.description: Strategic analysis of global capital restructuring. Today's focus: the systemic impacts of the new U.S. tariff regime, the $40 trillion fiscal dominance crisis, China's weaponization of critical minerals, and the nuclear renaissance driven by AI energy demands.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 31, 2026
item.description: Strategic forensic accounting analysis of offshore network deconstruction. Today's focus: dismantling dark capital architecture, FATF regulations, SEC Schedule 13D/G amendments, and a practical case study exposing hidden beneficial ownership.
